correct_completion: I will buy one at the shop.
full_sentence: I need a pen, so I will buy one at the shop.
acceptable_variants: I will borrow one from my friend.

options.why_wrong: This contradicts 'I need a pen', so it cannot follow 'so' as a result.

options.text: I will buy an egg at the shop.
options.why_wrong: 'An egg' is a different noun. The completion must refer back to the pen, so 'one' is needed.

options.text: I will buy one at the shop.

options.why_wrong: This gives unrelated information and does not show the result of needing a pen.

grammar_focus: Using 'one' to replace a countable noun after 'a'
explanation: After 'so', we need a result of the need. English uses 'one' to replace a countable noun already mentioned, instead of repeating it. Portuguese speakers may be tempted to repeat the noun here, but English avoids that repetition.
translation: Eu preciso de uma caneta, então vou comprar uma na loja.
